headline: Red main cleared, PLAICRAFT S2 dataset pipeline lands
lede: The nightly roster drift that froze the factory got a standalone two-line fix and a re-dispatched nightly, and the studio's S2 export — store to versioned, split, voice-aligned dataset in one command — is now on main, verified 30/30 in checkout.

notes.text: PLAICRAFT S2 pipeline merged (#2801): one command turns the recording store into a digest-versioned dataset with whole-person/whole-seed splits, tick-aligned voice and an honest acceptance card; check runs 30/30 green.
Red main (roster drift, 4th sighting) fixed standalone (#2804) — the same freeze was blocking the game PR; a PR-time gate for the class is filed (#2806).

Two independent S2 builds ran in parallel this shift; the second closed itself as superseded with full evidence attached (prod double-run: 11 human takes, 10.1 hours, 8 voiced) instead of shipping a duplicate — collisions resolved with records, not PR fights.
#1712 now waits on DATA, not code: 2+ named humans in 2+ games — the takes question (#2799) and a legacy-label policy call are with Jon.
